title.en: Which machine mixes and pumps a self-built pour on the grid, read as separate catalogue cells
title.zh: 有电网时，哪台机器能又搅拌又泵送自建浇筑，各格分开读

description.en: Keep this cell as published. The electric Integrated Mixer Pump, when the site can feed it. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints rural and self-built house pouring on this machine, together with “mix and pump in one unit”: main motor 45 kW, mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 4500 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. The category text says it is not a concrete mixing plant.
description.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：现场供得起电时，用电动搅拌泵一体机。邢台河北品锦机械在这台机器上印了农村与自建房浇筑，以及“搅拌与泵送一体”：主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、4500 kg。分类说明写明它不是混凝土搅拌站。

h1.en: Which machine mixes and pumps a self-built pour on the grid, read as separate catalogue cells
h1.zh: 有电网时，哪台机器能又搅拌又泵送自建浇筑，各格分开读

directAnswer.en: Keep this cell as published. The electric Integrated Mixer Pump, when the site can feed it. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints rural and self-built house pouring on this machine, together with “mix and pump in one unit”: main motor 45 kW, mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 4500 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. The category text says it is not a concrete mixing plant.
directAnswer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：现场供得起电时，用电动搅拌泵一体机。邢台河北品锦机械在这台机器上印了农村与自建房浇筑，以及“搅拌与泵送一体”：主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、4500 kg。分类说明写明它不是混凝土搅拌站。

body.en: “Lift pump” is an outline label from “Piston pump”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Keep this cell as published. The Integrated Mixer Pump: 45 kW plus 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 15 is 450 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. The page notes “30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer.” This application uses the printed 45 kW / 14 kW and 21 m³/h row. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Piston_pump
body.zh: “提升泵”是《Piston pump》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。这一格照已印出的读：搅拌泵一体机：45 kW 加 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。它不是搅拌站。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Piston_pump

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Force pump” from “Piston pump”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is not a mixing plant. Read it in the Xingtai table. The rural diesel is 800 kg. Taken from the printed row: It does not split new performance numbers for those series names. Keep this cell as published. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. 4 cm and below is this mixer pump’s cell.
body.zh: 本节保留《Piston pump》的标题“力泵”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。现场供得起电时，用电动搅拌泵一体机。邢台河北品锦机械在这台机器上印了农村与自建房浇筑，以及“搅拌与泵送一体”：主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、4500 kg。分类说明写明它不是混凝土搅拌站。按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。格子是水平/垂直 100 m / 300 m。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Single-acting pumps” in “Piston pump”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. The electric Integrated Mixer Pump, when the site can feed it. Taken from the printed row: This mixer pump is a 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm unit. Keep this cell as published. Off-grid mixing and pumping is the diesel mixer, not this electric unit. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Read it in the Xingtai table. No.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Piston pump》的“单作用泵组”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：电动15是 450 kg。农村柴油泵是 800 kg。这台搅拌泵是 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm 的设备。作业确实要同时搅拌和泵送，并且管路落在 100 m / 300 m 内时才用它。只需要浇筑的短二次结构管路，留在紧凑泵上。目录里已经写着：不适用。电动15印的是 1–3 cm。4 cm 及以下是这台搅拌泵的格子。

body.en: “Piston pump” breaks its subject at “Double-acting pumps”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints rural and self-built house pouring on this machine, together with “mix and pump in one unit”: main motor 45 kW, mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 4500 kg. Keep this cell as published. Use it when the job really is mixing and pumping together and the pipe fits 100 m / 300 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Say the site must mix and pump, and confirm power for 45 kW plus 14 kW. Read it in the Xingtai table. The cell is 100 m / 300 m, horizontal / vertical.
body.zh: 《Piston pump》在“双作用泵组”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。目录里已经写着：页面注明“30 系列配 400 搅拌，40/50 系列配 500 搅拌”。本应用使用已印的 45 kW / 14 kW 和 21 m³/h 这一行。不为那些系列名称另拆性能数字。无电网的搅拌加泵送是柴油搅拌泵，不是这台电机型。这一格照已印出的读：没有。

body.en: Borrow “Fluctuation in delivery rate” from “Piston pump” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. The category text says it is not a concrete mixing plant. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A short secondary-structure line that only needs placement stays on the compact pumps. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Taken from the printed row: No.
body.zh: 把《Piston pump》的“波动输送速率”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：请说明现场必须搅拌并泵送，并确认能供给 45 kW 加 14 kW。

question.zh: 在“提升泵”这一节里，300 m 是水平吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. The cell is 100 m / 300 m, horizontal / vertical.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：不是。格子是水平/垂直 100 m / 300 m。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Force pump” — Does 4 cm aggregate apply to Electric 15?
question.zh: “力泵”旁边仍要印着的是什么：4 cm 骨料适用于电动15吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm. 4 cm and below is this mixer pump’s cell.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。不适用。电动15印的是 1–3 cm。4 cm 及以下是这台搅拌泵的格子。

question.en: “Single-acting pumps” does not change the check: Is a mixing plant listed?
question.zh: “单作用泵组”不改这一问：列出搅拌站了吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。
